## About
Japanese Auto Repair is a local, family-owned and operated shop in San Marcos. We take care of drivers here and in Kyle, Buda, New Braunfels and Wimberley.
Our mechanics handle everyday maintenance like oil changes, plus brakes, suspension, front-end work and computer diagnostics. We aim for quality, reliable work at fair prices.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 76 reviews on Google. Give us a call and tell us what your car is doing.

## Services
- Brake repairs and installations: Brake work, from repairs to full installations.
- Shock installation: New shocks for a smoother ride.
- Strut installation: Strut installation as part of your suspension service.
- Front-end work: Front-end service to keep your car handling the way it should.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running well.
- Computer diagnostics: We read your car's computer to track down what's wrong.
- Tune-ups and AC repairs: Tune-ups and air conditioning repair for your car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and we'll give you a free estimate on your auto repair.

Q: Is there a warranty on your work?
A: We offer a 1-year warranty on parts and labor. Ask us about it when you call.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're located in San Marcos and serve drivers from San Marcos, Kyle, Buda, New Braunfels and Wimberley.
